name: meteor-react
description: Use when building or debugging React interfaces in Meteor 3: meteor create --react, createRoot, JSX or TSX entry points, Rspack React detection, Fast Refresh, react-meteor-data, useTracker, useSubscribe, useFind, withTracker, Suspense, and Tracker.withComputation. Triggers on isLoading being treated as a boolean, useFind receiving fetch(), stale closure inputs, duplicate tracker side effects, unstable Suspense keys, lost reactivity after await, state reset after refresh, or React tests leaking computations. Use this skill when the user asks about a React skeleton, React Compiler, React-specific rspack.config rules, reactive data hooks, or classic versus Suspense integration. Route general bundler configuration to meteor-modern-build-stack and Meteor 2 upgrades to migrate-to-meteor-3.
